review.head: 04a1d1c2407241a0c7932733f0b441e851682d2f
review.notes: Full review of the README and Suggested.lean. Seeded sample 9.10a-9.13b: Kollar, Singularities of pairs (arXiv alg-geom/9601026) checked at 2.16, 3.3-3.5, 5.7-5.10, 6.1, 6.4-6.11. Lazarsfeld 2004, Kollar-Mori 1998 and Angehrn-Siu 1995 are paywalled and were not verifiable. Suppliers checked on main: AlgebraicModuli 1.6 and 9.10-9.11, AlgebraicModuliPartII 0.7 and 1.5-1.7, SchemeAndStackFoundations Layers 2 and 5 and 4.17, ResolutionOfSingularities 5.1, 5.5, 5.6, 7.7. Every automatic check passed. Depcheck: 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates cleanly (no declarations). A probe statement of headline 9.12c at the pins elaborates (R04). Findings: R01 a missing effectivity hypothesis makes 9.12b and Summary items (2) and (4) false (counterexample on P^1); R02 supplier drift, with asymptotic Riemann-Roch for nef divisors, Kodaira's lemma and the divisorial Q-Cartier pullback owned by no roadmap; R03 9.13 and 9.13a restricted to number fields; R04 headline 9.12c statable but absent.
